name: independent-macos-computer-use
description: Independent local macOS background window automation over MCP. Normal Accessibility and Screen Recording grants required; app compatibility varies.

interface.longDescription: Observe occluded app windows with Accessibility, ScreenCaptureKit and local OCR. Operate using verified AX text insertion and process/window-directed events, with no automatic foreground fallback. Pointer routing uses undocumented macOS window-location SPI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect a macOS app window and help me complete a desktop task.
